title: REQ · preload.test.ts proves planner dedup, unknown refs and fallback key
summary: Engine-level preload cases are asserted in game/tests/preload.test.ts
description: Context: planPreload dedupes via a Set and splits load/unknown against the manifest; resolveTextureKey returns the fallback for undefined or unknown ids. Desired behavior: preload.test.ts asserts these with an in-memory manifest. Expected result: the three behaviors are covered in the requested file. Why: SG-5.4.3 done-when.
acceptance_criteria: Given two objects with asset 'A' in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then load equals ['A'] and unknown is []
Given asset 'Z' and dust asset 'Y' not in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then unknown equals ['Z','Y'] and load is []
Given id 'Z' or undefined, when resolveTextureKey runs with fallback 'fb', then 'fb' is returned; given 'A', then 'A'
